Here are a few methods to left-align a table caption in LaTeX without using the caption package:

1. Using `\raggedright`:
```latex
\begin{table}
\raggedright
\caption{Your caption text}
\begin{tabular}{...}
...
\end{tabular}
\end{table}
```

2. Using `\captionsetup` from the `caption` package (minimal import):
```latex
\usepackage{caption}
\captionsetup[table]{justification=raggedright,singlelinecheck=false}
```

3. Using `\makeatletter` and `\makeatother`:
```latex
\makeatletter
\long\def\@makecaption#1#2{%
  \vskip\abovecaptionskip
  \sbox\@tempboxa{#1: #2}%
  \ifdim \wd\@tempboxa >\hsize
    \raggedright #1: #2\par
  \else
    \global \@minipagefalse
    \hb@xt@\hsize{\hfil\box\@tempboxa\hfil}%
  \fi
  \vskip\belowcaptionskip}
\makeatother
```

Choose the method that best fits your document's structure.
